title: Design System: Coursmith · 智课工坊

display.purpose: Homepage Chinese serif heading; partial self-hosted subset with Chinese serif fallback.

body.purpose: Public interface and reading text; Manrope Latin and Chinese sans-serif fallback.

editor.purpose: Source textarea; monospace with Chinese fallback.

shadows.name: public-surface
shadows.purpose: Public authentication forms and course-card hover.

motion.name: book-arrive
motion.purpose: Homepage book arrives from translateY(9px) rotate(-3deg) to rotate(-6deg).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto
motion.purpose: Applied with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; public automatic scroll on root, operations automatic scroll on all elements.

breakpoints.name: public-compact-header
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width; public header navigation occupies its own row.

breakpoints.name: admin-small
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width; dashboard/login/filter stacking and compact gutters.

breakpoints.name: public-mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width; public hero/detail stacking, compact course cards and reading shell.

breakpoints.name: production-mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width; production columns stack and editor padding reduces.

breakpoints.name: admin-mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width; sidebar becomes native disclosure in document flow.

breakpoints.name: admin-desktop-nav
breakpoints.purpose: Minimum width; navigation remains visible even when disclosure open state is absent.

breakpoints.name: public-tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width; course card grid becomes one column and gutters reduce.

breakpoints.name: editor-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width; Markdown editor source and saved preview stack.

breakpoints.name: admin-tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width; operations sidebar and gutters reduce.

breakpoints.name: public-lone-card
breakpoints.purpose: Minimum width; lone course card uses a maximum 720px grid track.

breakpoints.name: production-wide-form
breakpoints.purpose: Minimum width; title form uses two columns with first label spanning both.

extensions.tonalRampNote: Tonal ramps are illustrative OKLCH lightness variations synthesized from source hex hue/chroma for the panel. They are not implemented palette tokens or approved UI colors.

components.css: .ds-course { display:grid; grid-template-columns:36% minmax(0,1fr); background:var(--paper, #fff); border:1px solid var(--line, #dde3dc); border-radius:10px; overflow:hidden; text-decoration:none; color:var(--ink, #202c27); min-height:240px; font-family:var(--sans, 'Manrope', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif); transition:color .2s,background .2s,box-shadow .2s,transform .2s; } .ds-course:hover { transform:translateY(-3px); box-shadow:var(--shadow, 0 14px 32px rgba(35,65,44,.07)); border-color:#b5c5b1; } .ds-course:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #487254; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-cover { background:#e7ebdf; color:var(--green, #234b3e); display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:space-between; padding:24px; font-size:.75rem; min-width:0; } .ds-cover svg { width:100%; margin:15px 0; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-course-body { padding:26px; display:flex; align-items:flex-start; flex-direction:column; min-width:0; } .ds-pill { background:#eef2eb; color:#3e5c46; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:4px; font-size:.7rem; line-height:1.5; } .ds-course h3 { font-size:1.15rem; font-weight:650; line-height:1.45; margin:13px 0 8px; } .ds-course p { color:var(--muted, #626d65); font-size:.82rem; line-height:1.8; margin:0 0 20px; } .ds-course-bottom { font-size:.78rem; width:100%; margin-top:auto; padding-top:16px; border-top:1px solid var(--line, #dde3dc); color:var(--green, #234b3e); } @media(max-width:700px) { .ds-course { grid-template-columns:30% minmax(0,1fr); min-height:230px; } .ds-cover { padding:18px 12px; font-size:.65rem; } .ds-course-body { padding:20px; } .ds-course h3 { font-size:1.05rem; } } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-course { transition:none; } }

narrative.overview:
Coursmith pairs a calm, bookish learning website with a practical operations workspace. Paper-white grounds, dark green actions, and restrained borders give real course content and production tasks room to breathe. The book motif is a webpage graphic made from layered shapes and line drawings.

Chinese serif headlines distinguish learning and introductory moments. The denser administrative interface uses sans-serif hierarchy, grouped navigation, readable forms, and tables. Shared colors and local fonts connect the surfaces while their density remains appropriate to their work.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-white surfaces, green actions, and quiet ink text.
Serif learning headlines with sans-serif interface text.
Bordered panels and tonal grouping, with selective soft shadows.
Explicit actions, visible keyboard focus, and responsive native navigation.

rules.name: The Surface Neutrals Rule
rules.body: Keep the public and operations neutral sets with their respective surfaces; share the green action color.

rules.name: The Saved Preview Rule
rules.body: Describe the editor preview as saved content and make saving explicit; retain visible unsaved-input recovery.

dos: **Do** use the surface-specific neutral set with the shared green action color.
**Do** preserve local font loading and Chinese fallback stacks, including fallback for the partial serif subset.
**Do** retain visible keyboard focus, native controls, native disclosure navigation, and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** allow long code and tables to scroll within their containers and stack editor columns at the implemented breakpoint.
**Do** label saved previews and unsaved recovery accurately, keeping real server form and revision behavior.
donts: **Don't** imply that the bundled Noto Serif SC subset covers all Chinese characters.
**Don't** replace textual course or production state with color alone.
**Don't** reuse the illustration's rotated pages, arched backdrop, or book shadow as the default form or table treatment.
**Don't** imply autosave, completed human review, or invented course facts through interface copy or state styling.
